## Deploying care-preview with    Cloudflare Pages
Latest commit: d40c9ea
Status: ✅  Deploy successful!
Preview URL: https://164ac5f9.care-preview-a7w.pages.dev
Branch Preview URL: https://copilot-fix-print-config-set.care-preview-a7w.pages.dev
[View logs](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/db6d08276fae8cc36808cc6d13f71ca6/pages/view/care-preview/164ac5f9-3626-4333-8628-efecc4dc5886)

Hard-coding `autoPrint={false}` makes every new dialog-based token/QR print flow ignore the resolved facility template’s `print_setup.auto_print` value. This conflicts with the PR’s goal that print pages use facility configuration. The dialog should allow the template/prop value through, with dialog-specific completion behavior (close the dialog instead of `history.go(-1)`) added to the auto-print hook.

This test imports `pdfjs-dist` directly, but the package is not declared in `package.json`; it is currently present only as a transitive dependency of `react-pdf` (`package-lock.json:11679-11689`). Depending on hoisting makes the test vulnerable to module-resolution failures when that dependency graph changes. Add `pdfjs-dist` as a direct dev dependency and update the lockfile.
